objectives: Hear /s/ followed immediately by /k/ in taught words.
Blend /s/ and /k/ without inserting an extra vowel.
Distinguish sk from sl, st, and sw onsets.
Say the complete word after blending the onset with the remaining sounds.
concepts: The initial sk blend contains /s/ followed by /k/.
Both consonant sounds remain in the onset.
An extra vowel should not be inserted between the consonants.
The full word confirms accurate blending.

definitions.definition: Two consonant sounds heard together at the beginning of a word.
